topic_map.authoring: Ideal-gas interaction approximation excludes brief collisions; kinetic/potential comparison qualified by the interaction-energy zero convention.
Microscopic ideal model and macroscopic equation2-19 remain linked; real gases are not asserted to obey it under all conditions. Historical equation names retained and declared.
Rarefaction, molecular separation/size, negligible occupied volume and attraction; temperature and interaction conditions qualified; brief repulsive collisions remain in the model.
Steel-ball analogy retained as a model; molecular masses/internal structure and limitations retained.
Pressure-calculation purpose retained; applicability qualified by negligible interaction and approximately elastic collision assumptions.
Statistical rather than trajectory-by-trajectory description; experimental basis, random motion, collision changes and collective regularities retained.
Thermal-equilibrium/isotropy/rest-frame assumptions; direction symmetry is statistical, not exact instantaneous finite counts. Street/parade analogy retained with its limits.
Average-speed and class-age analogy retained; averaging squared speeds distinguished from squaring the average. Equation3-1 and n as molecular count retained.
Orthogonal-coordinate identity, signed components and their squares; Pythagorean footnote retained; average-of-sums identity3-3 distinguished from an isotropy assumption.
Equal component mean squares and factor1/3 explicitly require isotropy; three-dimensional component count alone is insufficient. Equations3-4/3-5 and original token order retained.
